title: bug: an interactive architect whose row ends without submit_plan (archive_task, e.g. every defect-hunt row) claims its next PLANNING row in-session on the Claude account the fleet already switched away from, because claim_next_task never answers accountSwitch and the moe-account-switch mod marks only submit_plan and chat_wait (4 times on 11-03/11-04, acct-1 at 99%)
description:
Filed by defect hunt #18 (task-1c736204, lane 2: the wrapper side of Claude account rotation), 2026-11-04.

PROBLEM
- An interactive architect is told to switch accounts only by a reply that carries `accountSwitch`. The mod sets `acceptsAccountSwitch` only on submit_plan and chat_wait, and reads the switch only from submit_plan, chat_wait and complete_step:
  - scripts/mods/moe-account-switch/hooks/register.ts:43 `const MARKED = new Set(['submit_plan', 'chat_wait'])`;
  - :45 `SIGNALS = new Set(['submit_plan', 'chat_wait', 'complete_step'])`;
  - claim_next_task is only in HELD (:47), which refuses a claim only AFTER the mod already knows a switch is pending; the mark is applied at :282.
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/claimNextTask.ts has no account logic. Its inputSchema is `additionalProperties: false` (:425), so it cannot take the flag either.
- The daemon already has the between-tasks check: accountStore.ts:525 idleSwitchFor() (null while the seat holds a task). chatWait.ts:63-71 uses it, and submitPlan.ts:727 uses accountSwitchFor. No claim path asks it.
- Result: a row that ends WITHOUT submit_plan, then an in-session `moe.claim_next_task` (the role doc's loop), hands the seat a new task on the spent account. The switch only lands at the next submit_plan, after a whole plan was drafted on the spent account.
  - Defect-hunt rows end that way by design: "do not call moe.submit_plan ... archive this row yourself".

EVIDENCE
- Live, 2026-11-04 (.moe/activity.log, logs/moe-usage, ~/.moe/claude-usage/acct-1.json):
  - architect-c33f294e launched on acct-1 at 06:27:06Z (receipt ce756cea).
  - ACCOUNT_SWITCHED acct-1→acct-2 at 06:40:28.796Z (fromPeakPercent 91, switchAtPercent 90; #governors msg-2d4c62f8).
  - TASK_ARCHIVED task-3488566e at 06:52:31.995Z, then TASK_UPDATED assignedWorkerId=architect-c33f294e on task-3950184e at 06:52:35.537Z.
  - PLAN_SUBMITTED at 07:01:20.260Z. acct-1 five_hour read 99% at 07:00:36Z.
  - The relaunch on acct-2 came only at 07:02:55Z.
- The same sequence (hunt row archived, then an in-session claim after a fleet switch) happened 3 times on 11-03 for architect-1dd28c7c: 17:05:48Z, 18:21:02Z, 23:31:37Z.
  - /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-1c736204/A/c1-inSessionClaim/occurrences.txt and real-artifacts.txt.
- Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-1c736204/A/c1-inSessionClaim/inSessionClaimSwitch.test.ts, run from packages/moe-daemon/src/__hunt__/ of a `git archive 320918dc` snapshot (`npx vitest run src/__hunt__/inSessionClaimSwitch.test.ts`). It fails at HEAD (vitest-output.txt):
  - expected {hasNext:false, claimedTask:null, nextAssignee:null, switchFrom:'acct-1', switchTo:'acct-2'};
  - received {hasNext:true, claimedTask:'task-next', nextAssignee:'architect-a', switchFrom:null, switchTo:null}.

FIX DIRECTION
- claim_next_task accepts the mod's flag. Reuse ACCEPTS_ACCOUNT_SWITCH from accountStore.ts, as submit_plan and chat_wait do.
- With the flag set and idleSwitchFor(state, workerId) non-null, it claims nothing and returns `{ hasNext: false, accountSwitch: accountSwitchReply(change, <end your session; the wrapper relaunches on the next account and claims the next task>) }`, with no claim nextAction.
  - Error handling: run the check before any claim branch writes. A seat holding a task keeps today's alreadyAssigned reply (idleSwitchFor is null).
  - A call without the flag (the wrapper pre-flight claim, headless seats, governors) is unchanged.
- The mod adds 'claim_next_task' to MARKED and SIGNALS, so it sets the flag and ends the session on that reply, exactly as for submit_plan.
- Sync your own `### moe.claim_next_task` section of docs/MCP_SERVER.md: the flag and the reply. Edit only that section (ruling msg-71db57ac).

FILES (5): packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/claimNextTask.ts; packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/accountTools.test.ts (or a new claimNextTask.accountSwitch.test.ts); scripts/mods/moe-account-switch/hooks/register.ts; scripts/mods/moe-account-switch/hooks/register.test.ts; docs/MCP_SERVER.md (own section only).
Placement: none of these is held by an open row at filing (lanes.js 08:05Z). No dependsOn. Out of scope: role-doc wording (architect.md / architect.reference.md mention only submit_plan) and the launchers.
definitionOfDone: A daemon vitest (accountTools.test.ts or a new claimNextTask.accountSwitch.test.ts) passes three cases. (1) An idle seat (no currentTaskId) leased on an account past switchAtPercent, calling claim_next_task with acceptsAccountSwitch:true, gets hasNext:false and accountSwitch {from:'acct-1', to:'acct-2'}, with an instruction starting 'ACCOUNT-SWITCH:', and the PLANNING row stays unassigned. (2) The same call without the flag claims the row as today. (3) A seat that already holds a task gets the unchanged alreadyAssigned reply.

`grep -n "const MARKED\|const SIGNALS" scripts/mods/moe-account-switch/hooks/register.ts` shows claim_next_task in both sets, and register.test.ts has a passing case in which a claim_next_task reply carrying accountSwitch, then the main turn completing, leads to /exit after EXIT_DELAY_MS.

`grep -n acceptsAccountSwitch docs/MCP_SERVER.md` shows the flag inside the moe.claim_next_task section, and `npx vitest run src/tools/claimNextTask.test.ts src/tools/accountTools.test.ts` passes in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.

implementationPlan.description:
Daemon, test first, then implement: claim_next_task answers a due between-task account switch. Read mem:decision-account-switch-end-session first.

TEST FIRST (red at HEAD) in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/accountTools.test.ts, inside the existing `describe('switching accounts between tasks')` (:244), beside the submit_plan and chat_wait cases (:257-353). Reuse that describe's lease and usage setup. The hunt repro /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-1c736204/A/c1-inSessionClaim/inSessionClaimSwitch.test.ts shows a full fixture: the accounts file, then lease_account, report_account_usage 0.91, archive_task, then the claim. Add a `claim(workerId, acceptsAccountSwitch = true)` helper that calls claimNextTaskTool(state).handler({ workerId, statuses: ['PLANNING'], acceptsAccountSwitch }, state), with an unassigned PLANNING row in the fixture. Cases, with mutation-resistant assertions:
- (a) An idle seat (no currentTaskId) leased on acct-1 past switchAtPercent, with the flag:
  - hasNext === false;
  - accountSwitch.from === 'acct-1' and accountSwitch.to === 'acct-2';
  - accountSwitch.instruction starts with 'ACCOUNT-SWITCH:' and contains 'Claim nothing more';
  - no nextAction key;
  - the PLANNING row's assignedWorkerId is still null, no attempt was opened for it, and the seat's currentTaskId is still null.
- (b) The same state without the flag claims the row exactly as today: hasNext true, the task id, the assignee set.
- (c) With the flag but under switchAtPercent, the claim is normal and the reply has no accountSwitch key.
- (d) With the flag, a seat that already holds a task gets the unchanged alreadyAssigned reply, with no accountSwitch.
- (e) With the flag, a seat that never leased claims normally.
Also update the file's header comment (:19-21) to name claim_next_task.

IMPLEMENT in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/claimNextTask.ts:
- Import ACCEPTS_ACCOUNT_SWITCH, accountSwitchReply and idleSwitchFor from '../state/accountStore.js'. The models are submitPlan.ts:20/:726-768 and chatWait.ts:7/:63-71/:402-409.
- Add `acceptsAccountSwitch: ACCEPTS_ACCOUNT_SWITCH` to inputSchema.properties (:395-424), keeping additionalProperties:false, and add `acceptsAccountSwitch?: unknown` to the params type (:436-447).
- Put the check inside the runExclusive, right AFTER the `if (params.workerId) { blockingHold ... ownFinalizingAttempt ... }` block (ends about :550) and BEFORE `let tasks: Task[]`, i.e. before any ranking, eligibility scan, eviction or assignment write:
  - if `params.acceptsAccountSwitch === true && params.workerId` and `idleSwitchFor(state, params.workerId)` returns a change, log logger.info({ workerId, to }, 'Claim skipped: Claude account switch due');
  - then return `{ hasNext: false, accountSwitch: accountSwitchReply(change, `Claim nothing more and end your turn now: Moe restarts this seat on ${change.toLabel}, and the new session claims the next task.`) }`.
  - Return NO nextAction: a claim or wait hint would put the next task on the spent account.
- The order keeps every existing answer first: the governor redirect, the status validation, the refreshWorkerType/endReloadHold bookkeeping, alreadyAssigned and resume (idleSwitchFor is null while currentTaskId is set), and ATTEMPT_FINALIZING.
- A call without the flag (the wrapper pre-flight claim, headless seats) must stay byte-for-byte unchanged.
- Error handling: idleSwitchFor and accountSwitchFor already return null on an unreadable or missing registry or no lease, so the claim proceeds. Add no try/catch that could hide a claim error.
- Append one sentence to the tool description: 'With acceptsAccountSwitch (set only by the moe-account-switch mod), a seat holding no task whose Claude account must switch gets hasNext:false with accountSwitch instead of a claim and must end its turn.'
implementationPlan.note: claim_next_task: acceptsAccountSwitch (ACCEPTS_ACCOUNT_SWITCH) in the schema and params; the idleSwitchFor check sits inside the workerId block right after the ownFinalizingAttempt throw and before `let tasks`, returning {hasNext:false, accountSwitch: accountSwitchReply(change, 'Claim nothing more and end your turn now: Moe restarts this seat on <to>, and the new session claims the next task.')} with no nextAction. GREEN: tsc --noEmit 0; vitest accountTools+claimNextTask+contract+workerType+chatWait+submitPlan 6 files 348 passed. Mutant (flag gate `=== true` → `!== 42`) killed by case (b).

implementationPlan.description:
Verification, once, in a git-archive snapshot of your worktree HEAD outside the shared checkout (never npm install, build or test in place; use Linux node_modules for packages/moe-daemon). Run this exact command from the snapshot root and submit its fresh output as complete_task evidence:

`(cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/accountTools.test.ts src/tools/claimNextTask.test.ts src/tools/claimNextTask.contract.test.ts src/tools/workerType.test.ts src/tools/chatWait.test.ts src/tools/submitPlan.test.ts) && env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" claude plugin test scripts/mods/moe-account-switch`

- All must pass. The new daemon cases (a)-(e) and the mod cases must have been red before the implementation: record the red runs in your step notes.
- env -i keeps this seat's live MOE_* variables out of the mod tests.
- Optional type check: `node moe-vscode/node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js -p scripts/mods/moe-account-switch/tsconfig.json`. Its only known baseline errors are TS5097 and TS2769 in register.test.ts.

Adversarial self-review of this diff, the final step. Check each point:
- Concurrency: two in-session claims both run inside runExclusive, and the switch answer writes nothing, so nothing can be half-written.
- The wrapper pre-flight claim never sends the flag: `grep -n acceptsAccountSwitch scripts/moe-agent.sh scripts/moe-agent.ps1` prints nothing.
- A governor with the flag still gets enter_governance.
- A seat with no worker record but a lease is switched; a seat with no lease, or an unreadable registry, claims normally.
- A resume of the seat's own task (currentTaskId set) is never switched.
- An explicit-taskId claim with the flag is switched exactly like a ranked one.
- Rollout order, which must go into the completion summary for the governor:
  - The mod part goes live as soon as it lands, because scripts/ is hot through moe/control. The daemon part goes live only after the human's daemon swap.
  - The live daemon ignores unknown arguments (McpAdapter.ts:321 passes params.arguments to the handler with no schema check), so until the swap the flag changes nothing.
  - If the claude client ever rejected the extra field against the old schema, the in-session claim would fail and the session would end idle. The wrapper's own pre-flight claim (no flag) then claims normally.
  - So ask the governor to restage the daemon after this lands.
- Error handling: no new throw path, and the claim refusals' order is unchanged.
- No forbidden pattern in the diff, and every DoD item maps to a passing test or grep.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: A seat holding no task, whose leased Claude account must switch, that calls moe.claim_next_task with acceptsAccountSwitch:true (only the moe-account-switch mod sets it) gets { hasNext:false, accountSwitch } and no claim. The mod then ends the session after the turn, and the wrapper relaunches it on the next account.
invariants: claim_next_task without acceptsAccountSwitch behaves exactly as before
the switch answer writes nothing: no assignment, no attempt, no worker change
the governor redirect, alreadyAssigned, resume and ATTEMPT_FINALIZING answers keep precedence and shape
the switch reply carries no nextAction
compatibility: additive optional input; the live daemon (no schema validation at McpAdapter.ts:321) ignores it until swapped
the wrapper pre-flight claims never send the flag
reuse: accountStore.ts idleSwitchFor, accountSwitchReply and ACCEPTS_ACCOUNT_SWITCH, as used by chat_wait and submit_plan

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Have the daemon refuse every claim on a spent account, with no flag. Rejected: the wrapper's pre-flight claim runs before its fresh lease, while fleet.leases may still name the last session's spent account, so it would refuse every relaunch. The flag limits the switch to sessions that can end themselves, exactly as submit_plan and chat_wait do. (2) Have the mod hold claim_next_task by itself, reading the usage sample. Rejected: the daemon owns the eligibility rule (accountSwitchFor: spent, refused, signed out or removed, and another eligible account exists). The mod has only its own sample and would disagree with the fleet. (3) A role-doc instruction telling architects to stop after an archive_task. Rejected: prose; the mod enforces it.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- accountStore.ts:525 idleSwitchFor is null while the seat holds a task, so the alreadyAssigned and resume paths are untouched by construction.
- accountSwitchReply builds the 'ACCOUNT-SWITCH:' instruction that the mod keys on.
- In the mod, MARKED adds the flag only for leased seats (MOE_ACCOUNT_ID set), SIGNALS reads only the top-level accountSwitch, and HELD refuses later work once a switch is pending.
- McpAdapter.ts:321 does no input-schema validation, so the schema property is documentation and client-facing only.
- claim_next_task is blocking:true with its own runExclusive (claimNextTask.ts:391, :435).
planningNotes.risks:
- Placement: putting the check before the blockingHold or finalizing answers would change their replies. Put it after them and before the ranking.
- Existing register.test.ts cases that compare claim_next_task call args exactly gain the flag on leased seats; update only those assertions.
- Rollout order between the hot mod and the swapped daemon is benign: the old daemon ignores the flag, and the worst case is an idle session end followed by the wrapper's own claim. Say so in the completion summary.
- scripts/CLAUDE.md:42 stays stale until task-3416b309 lands, as a noted follow-up.
